notes: Single panel. Derby Av. along the top (printed 42.52' at both ends of the sheet; read as 42.52 ft) from the left edge to Euclid, then angled north-east to the top edge (the north-east leg ends against Mitchell just above the sheet top, not picked). Edgewood (label EDGEWOOD, between sheets 653 and 654) T's in from the north. S. Circle Av. / Maple Av. run down the left edge (S. CIRCLE AV. label north of the S. Circle stub, MAPLE AV. south of it, 42 ft); their west face is off the paper so the three left-edge points are taken from the east face and the water pipe. Euclid Av. runs east from the bottom-left as a 40 ft street, turns north-east, then turns north (50 ft) to Derby; the 50' is printed on the north-south section and 40' on the diagonal, so Euclid is listed as 40 ft. Mitchell Av. (40 ft north of the railroad, 50 ft south) crosses the upper right diagonally with no street meeting it on the sheet. The C.H.&D. railroad crosses the bottom; the block east of Euclid has only lot lines. No alleys.
